title: Repair or retire broken Python fallback entrypoints
description: Remove broken Python-first assumptions from the remaining utility scripts and docs, or restore a bounded Python fallback that is explicit and actually works in the current repository.

criteria: No default operational script points at a missing Python src entrypoint
Fallback policy is explicit: restored and validated, or retired and documented
README startup and build instructions match repository reality
convergence.definition_of_done: The repository no longer treats a broken Python path as an authoritative default.

implementation.title: Choose bounded fallback policy
implementation.description: Decide whether Python fallback remains as an explicit, validated override or is retired from default instructions.

implementation.title: Update scripts to match the chosen policy
implementation.description: Repair or replace the current src assumptions in the Python utility layer.

implementation.title: Refresh operator-facing docs
implementation.description: Make sure README and related guidance no longer advertise dead startup or build paths.
